_README2: Optimized for Formula Student / FSAE CFD. Change only case_name & stl_files when testing new models.
_stl_files: ASCII STL geometry files located in stl/ directory
_fidelity: Presets: 'fast' (~2-4M cells, 10 min), 'standard' (~6-9M cells, 45 min, RECOMMENDED for FSAE), 'fine' (~12-16M cells)

flow._comment: Flow conditions: velocity in m/s (16.67 m/s ≈ 60 km/h); ground=true enables moving road

outputs._comment: Axis projection: drag along flow (-z) and downforce towards ground (-y)

_domain_box_comment: 'auto' automatically fits wind tunnel around STL bounds and aligns ground/symmetry. Or provide explicit {'min': [...], 'max': [...]}.
_symmetry_plane_comment: Centerline coordinate if car symmetry plane is NOT at 0.0 (e.g. -0.1185 for RP14). Omit or set 0.0 if centered at 0.
_ground_comment: Optional ground level (delete leading '_' from either key to activate):
_ground_clearance_desc: Style 1 (Relative): Gap in meters below lowest STL point (e.g. 0.035 = 35mm front wing ride height)
_ground_plane_desc: Style 2 (Absolute): Fixed CAD coordinate of road (e.g. 0.0 if wing is in car assembly coordinates)
_domain_faces: Boundary types for the 6 outer box faces: inlet, outlet, ground, farField, symmetry

parallel._comment: Number of CPU cores for MPI decomposition, meshing, and solving

slurm._comment: SLURM cluster configuration for CU e-Science cluster
slurm._use_tmpdir: true = run in fast node scratch ($TMPDIR) with live sync; false = run in-place in case dir

_comment_overrides: Expert overrides — all fields below have built-in FSAE defaults in fidelity presets. Uncomment only if manual tuning is needed.
